title: Conversation REST routes
objective: Add list and create conversation endpoints with validation, ordering, timestamps, and persistence tests.
context: Titles must be non-empty and at most 200 characters.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/conversations returns [] for an empty database.
POST /api/conversations returns 201 with UUID id, title, created_at, and updated_at.
Empty and too-long titles return 400 with error.code VALIDATION.
Created conversations persist and appear in descending updated_at order.
risk_notes: Timestamp strings should be consistent enough for deterministic ordering assertions.
Avoid DB query macros that require offline metadata.
